name: avatar-generator
title: Avatar Generator
description: Deterministic kawaii avatars drawn in code from a seed, after the Seline logo (black hair, white face, blushed cheeks), hand-inked by default (seeded wobble, pen-pressure strokes, open loops) or smooth vector lines: male/female/any hairstyles, eyes, mouth, top, skin tone and accessory parts, plus an editor with seed shuffle, gender and style toggles, part pickers, SVG download and JSX copy.
